Collab to connect Procore and IBM Maximo
Signals strategic product integration that could drive adoption among enterprise asset owners.
Focus on asset lifecycle data thread
Improved handover and maintenance data can reduce churn and increase stickiness with owners.
If effective, may expand PCOR’s role post-construction, enlarging TAM.
Immediate product availability enables near-term customer trials and upsell.
